file_bucket.description: GCS bucket used to stage unstructured files. Required if you want Fivetran to replicate unstructured files.

file_folder.description: GCS folder within `fileBucket` used to stage unstructured files.

support_json_type.description: Stores JSON columns as JSON instead of STRING. This parameter is applicable only to destinations created before August 1, 2025.

external_secrets_keys_config.description: A JSON object mapping configuration field names to their corresponding secret key names in your external secrets manager. Requires `external_secrets_manager_id` to be set.
